items.title: 1.1 Tabi'i miqdarein (physical quantities) aur un ke units (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.1 with the chapter's opening paragraphs (PDF 4-5).

blocks.text: Physics tabi'i uloom (physical sciences) ki sab se bunyadi shakh hai: yeh woh bunyadi usool aur qawaneen deti hai jo doosri shakhon jaise astronomy, chemistry, geology, biology aur health sciences ke raaz samajhne mein madad karte hain, aur is ke auzaar, techniques aur paidawar ne hamare khwabon ko haqeeqat mein badla hai. Physics ek tajurbati (experimental) science hai, aur scientific method mukhtalif napi jane wali physical quantities ki durust paimaish (measurement) ki zaroorat par zor deta hai. Yeh chapter napne ki techniques aur record karne ki maharat ke tasawwur par zor deta hai.

Physics ki bunyad physical quantities par hai, jin ke zariye physics ke qawaneen bayan kiye jate hain; is liye in miqdaron ko durust napna zaroori hai. In mein mass, lambai (length), waqt, velocity, force, density, darja hararat (temperature), electric current aur bohat si doosri shamil hain.

blocks.title: Base aur derived quantities
blocks.text: Physical quantities aksar do qismon mein banti hain. Base quantities doosri physical quantities ke zariye bayan nahi hotin: yeh woh azaad (independent) quantities hain jin ke zariye baqi bayan ki ja sakti hain, maslan length, mass aur time. Derived quantities base quantities par munhasir hain, maslan velocity, acceleration aur force.

Base quantity ki paimaish mein do qadam hain: pehla, ek mayaar (standard) ka intikhab, aur doosra, napi jane wali quantity ka standard se muqabla karne ka tareeqa tay karna, taake us quantity ki paimaish ke taur par ek adad aur ek unit mil jaye. Paimaishein qabil-e-bharosa aur durust honi chahiye taake unhen aasani aur asar ke saath istemal kiya ja sake.

blocks.caption: Physical quantity ki do qismein
rows: azaad; doosri quantities ke zariye bayan nahi

blocks.prompt: Kya density base quantity hai ya derived, aur base quantity napne mein kaun se do qadam hain?
blocks.explanation: Density derived hai: yeh mass taqseem volume hai, aur volume khud length se aata hai. Base quantity napne ka matlab pehle standard chunna aur phir quantity ka us standard se muqabla karne ka tareeqa tay karna hai, jis se adad aur unit milte hain.

items: Physics tajurbati hai; us ke qawaneen physical quantities mein bayan hote hain jo durust napni chahiye.

Base quantities (length, mass, time) azaad hain; derived quantities (velocity, acceleration, force) un par munhasir. Base quantity napna: standard chunein, phir muqable ka tareeqa jo adad aur unit de.
